name: gpt-audio-plugin
description: Generate music from the current ChatGPT conversation and optional native audio attachments through GPTAudioMCP.

interface.shortDescription: Turn chat context and attached audio into generated music.
interface.longDescription: Stay in the normal ChatGPT conversation, optionally attach a recording with ChatGPT's native attachment control, and generate music through GPTAudioMCP using your connected provider account.
defaultPrompt: Generate music from our current conversation.
Use the audio file I attached and our conversation as the creative direction.
